name: atlan
description: Find, use and publish skills, agents, MCP servers and knowledge in the Atlan registry, through Atlan's remote MCP server and guided skills.

interface.shortDescription: Skills, agents and MCP from the Atlan registry
interface.longDescription: Connect your coding agent to the Atlan registry with one OAuth sign-in. Search your organization's skills, agents, knowledge and MCP servers, install a registry skill into the current project, reach every MCP server your organization registered through one gateway, and publish skills, agents and outputs back with the registry's own authoring recipes.
defaultPrompt: Show my organization's skills and agents in Atlan
Find an Atlan skill for this task and install it
Publish the skill in this folder to Atlan
